title: The Wild Swans
summary: A girl must craft magical items to free her brothers turned into swans.
coverScene: A young princess weaves shirts from green leaves while white swans fly near a stone castle.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a man lived in a great house.
He lived there with his children.
The oldest children were eleven brothers.
The youngest child was a good girl named Kizkardes.
They were very happy until a bad new mother came.
The woman did not love the children.
She sent the young girl away to a place far off.
The bad woman also changed the eleven brothers into animals.
The big animals flew far away across the water.
Kizkardes grew older and returned to find her family.
She walked through a deep forest.
Then she saw the beautiful animals near the sea.
The animals turned back into men when the light went down.
They told her about a dark problem.
Only a great deal could break it.
Kizkardes had to make eleven clothes from green plants.
She could never speak a single word until she finished.
The good girl began to pick the green leaves.
She worked day and night without rest.
She sat in a room all alone.
A young man found her during a trip.
He brought her to his house as his wife.
The man loved her nice face very much.
Bad people in the house told the man she was bad.
They led her to a high public place.
She would not answer their questions.
The good girl held the green clothes.
Eleven animals flew down from the top.
Kizkardes threw the green clothes over the big animals.
The problem broke.
The eleven brothers stood up as good young men.
The youngest brother still had one animal hand.
His clothes lacked a part.
The family lived happily ever after.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a king lived in a great house with his dear children.
The older children were eleven brothers.
The youngest was a sweet little girl named Kizkardes.
They were very happy until a bad new head came into their lives.
The woman did not love the children.
She sent the young girl away to a farm.
The bad head also changed the eleven brothers into wild birds with a dark spell.
The big birds flew far away across the water into another country.
When Kizkardes grew older, she returned to the house to find her family.
She walked through a deep forest until she saw the beautiful birds near the sea.
The birds turned back into men when the sun went down behind the mountains.
They told her about the dark spell which could only be broken by a great work.
Kizkardes had to make eleven shirts from green plants that grew near the dark holes.
She could never speak a single word until every shirt was completely finished.
The strong girl began to pick the green leaves and work day and night without rest.
She sat in a quiet place and made the clothes with her own hands.
A young king found her during a hunting trip.
He brought her to his big house as his wife.
Even though she never spoke to him, the king loved her nice face very much.
Some bad people in the house told the king that his wife was a bad person.
They led her to a high public square because she would not answer their questions.
While the people watched from below, the strong girl held the green shirts in her hands.
Eleven wild birds flew down from the sky and stood around her on the ground.
Kizkardes threw the green shirts over the big birds just in time.
The spell broke, and the eleven brothers stood up as healthy young men again.
The youngest brother still had one bird part because his shirt lacked a hand cover.
The woman's dark plan failed completely.
The family lived happily ever after.
If she had not finished the work, the spell would have stayed forever.
Now the brothers have returned to their home.
They have lived together in peace since that day.
The king has understood the truth about his dear wife.
They have built a wonderful life in the great house.
Every person in the country has known their story well.
The young girl has shown great strength and love for her family.

What rule did Kizkardes have to follow while making the shirts?
options: She could never speak a single word
She could never leave the dark cave

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a king lived in a great house with his dear children.
The oldest children were eleven brothers, and the youngest was a sweet little girl named Kizkardes.
They were very happy until a bad new leader came into their lives.
The leader did not love the children, and she sent the young girl away to a farm.
The terrible leader also changed the eleven brothers into wild birds with a dark spell.
The big birds flew far away across the water into another country.
When Kizkardes grew older, she returned to the house to find her family.
She walked through a deep forest until she saw the beautiful birds near the sea.
The birds turned back into men when the sun went down behind the mountains.
They told her about the severe spell which could only be broken by a great effort.
Kizkardes had to make eleven shirts from green plants that grew near the dark places.
She could never speak a single word until every shirt was completely finished.
The strong girl began to pick the green plants and work day and night without rest.
She sat in a quiet place and made the clothes with her own hands.
A young king found her during a hunting trip and brought her to his castle as his wife.
Even though she never spoke to him, the king loved her gentle face very much.
She worked very hard each day to finish the clothes for her brothers.
She sat by the window and picked the green plants until her hands were tired.
The king watched her from across the room and wondered about her silent life.
She never made any sound, but she always showed a kind smile to him.
Many people in the castle talked about her because she refused to speak.
However, the king protected her from all the bad words that other people said.
She continued to make the shirts because she loved her family so much.
Every single plant was important to the final success of her great task.
If she spoke just one word, her dear brothers would remain birds forever.
Therefore, she stayed quiet and kept working through the long hours of the night.
The green plants piled up around her chair as she worked without stopping.
She knew that her family depended entirely on her strength and focus.
The king often sat near her and tried to understand her quiet world.
He brought her food and water, but she only thanked him with her eyes.
The days passed quickly while she worked on the clothes in her small room.
She felt tired, but her heart remained strong because of her deep love.
The brothers flew near the castle every evening to check on her progress.
They watched her from the sky and hoped that she would succeed soon.
The time for the final test came closer with each passing week.
She gathered all the finished shirts and placed them carefully in a box.
Her fingers were tired from the work, but she felt happy and ready.
The plan was almost complete, and her family would soon be safe again.
She prepared herself for the final moment that would change everything.
Some bad people in the castle told the king that his wife was a bad person.
They led her to a high public square because she would not answer their questions.
While the people watched from below, the strong girl held the green shirts in her hands.
Eleven wild birds flew down from the sky and stood around her on the ground.
Kizkardes threw the green shirts over the big birds just in time.
The spell broke, and the eleven brothers stood up as healthy young men again.
The youngest brother still had one bird wing because his shirt lacked a part.
The leader's dark plan failed completely, and the family lived happily ever after.
The people in the square watched with great surprise as the birds became men.
The king ran forward and held his wife because he finally understood everything.
She looked at him and spoke her very first words with a happy smile.
The king was amazed to hear her voice for the very first time.
The brothers welcomed their sister and thanked her for her amazing strength.
The bad people who made trouble were driven away from the castle forever.
The king and his wife lived a wonderful life together with the eleven brothers.
The family stayed in the great house and never experienced any more trouble.
Everyone in the country celebrated the return of the strong young men.
The story of Kizkardes and her brothers became famous across the whole land.
People told the tale to their children for many years after that day.
The power of love and family had defeated the terrible dark spell.
Peace and joy returned to the country, and nothing could ever change it.

quiz.q: What happened to the eleven brothers because of the wicked queen?
options: They were changed into wild swans.
They were sent to a distant school.
They became kings of another country.

quiz.q: What rule did Kizkardes have to follow while making the shirts?
options: She could never speak a single word.
She had to finish them before the summer.
She was only allowed to work at night.

quiz.q: How did Kizkardes break the spell at the end of the story?
options: She threw the green shirts over the swans.
She spoke a magic word to the king.
She caught the birds in a large net.
